records.description: Support the person’s capacity, control policy, strategy use or self-monitoring.
records.rule: Use only when a person-level function is plausibly relevant and workflow redesign alone is unlikely to resolve the problem.

records.description: Reduce avoidable cognitive load or make relevant structure, sources, states and decision boundaries more visible.
records.rule: Prefer when the task or interface creates unnecessary load across otherwise capable users.

records.description: Improve communication, hand-offs, review stages, role clarity and coordination.
records.rule: Prefer when errors cluster around hand-offs, role ambiguity, missing checks or coordination failures.

records.description: Change incentives, authority, staffing, workload, policy or workflow architecture.
records.rule: Prefer when strain is systemic, widespread or created by organisational conditions rather than individual variation.
